target.scope: workspace_id from the existing request resolver; cross-workspace id is 404
target.revision: material_revision is the exact CAS token; every material writer bumps it

authority.mode: existing _require_supervisor (TEAM_LEAD+) plus service re-read of the current User row
authority.cancel: existing _require_run_access (run owner or supervisor) plus service re-check of active status and owner/TEAM_LEAD+
authority.claim: guarded no-op User UPDATE binds current status/role/raw tenant in the decision transaction

routes.effect: conditional UPDATE supervision_mode + material_revision, plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: same mode -> no_change/effect=none; valid mode -> verified; stale revision/material -> 409; same-operation replay -> already_applied

routes.effect: conditional UPDATE status=cancelled, clear waiting_on, append cancelled decision-log entry, bump material_revision, plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: owner or supervisor; legal transition required; terminal/illegal -> 409; stale revision -> 409; same-operation replay -> already_applied

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id goal-run:<mode|cancel>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw plan, parameters, decision log, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target state/revision digest must match

result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.GoalRunService: plan/parameters/cursor/wait/resume/transition writers advance material_revision; a concurrent write makes the decision stale
